Why Leg Veins Become Prominent

Varicose veins commonly develop when valves inside superficial leg veins do not close effectively. Blood can then pool, increasing pressure in the vein. Family history, increasing age, pregnancy, excess weight and long periods of standing or sitting may contribute.
